findings.problem: The test requires an index mutation made by a stand-in for `git commit` to be refused by the second pre-commit check. That stand-in runs after the second check, so this injection can only exercise the acknowledged residual window and post-commit detection. The specified test cannot demonstrate the required pre-commit refusal.
findings.suggestion: Inject the index mutation between the first and second digest checks, for example while the intervening cached whitespace check runs, and assert refusal with no commit. Separately use the `git commit` stand-in to test post-commit detection and the 'nothing was undone' report.

summary: The earlier findings are addressed. One remaining verification requirement places its race injection too late for the expected refusal.
